control.control:
Package: local.gofahud
Name: GOFA HUD (Rootless)
Version: 0.3.1
Architecture: iphoneos-arm64
Maintainer: GOFA HUD Development
Author: GOFA HUD contributors; GMapHUD base by chou
Section: Tweaks
Depends: firmware (>= 15.0), firmware (<< 17.0), mobilesubstrate, ldid, preferenceloader
Description: Bong bóng tốc độ và biển báo GOFA trên iPhone và CarPlay.
 Tương thích: Rootless (Dopamine), iOS 15 và 16.
 Cần GOFA 4.2.1; có log cài đặt và chẩn đoán.
Tag: role::enduser
control.postrm:
#!/var/jb/bin/sh
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
log_dir=/var/mobile/Library/Logs
mkdir -p "$log_dir"
log_file="$log_dir/GofaHUD-install.log"
touch "$log_file"; chmod 0644 "$log_file"
stamp() { TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'; }
printf '%s script=%s action=%s version=0.3.1 begin\n' "$(stamp)" "$0" "${1:-}" >> "$log_file"
trap 'result=$?; printf "%s script=%s exit=%s\n" "$(stamp)" "$0" "$result" >> "$log_file"' EXIT
run_output=$(/var/jb/bin/sh -s -- "$@" 2>&1 <<'GOFAHUD_SCRIPT_BODY'
case "${1:-}" in
    remove|purge) echo 'GOFA HUD removed. Respring to unload the bubbles.';;
esac
exit 0

GOFAHUD_SCRIPT_BODY
)
run_result=$?
printf "%s\n" "$run_output" >> "$log_file"
printf "%s\n" "$run_output"
exit "$run_result"

control.preinst:
#!/var/jb/bin/sh
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
log_dir=/var/mobile/Library/Logs
mkdir -p "$log_dir"
log_file="$log_dir/GofaHUD-install.log"
touch "$log_file"; chmod 0644 "$log_file"
stamp() { TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'; }
printf '%s script=%s action=%s version=0.3.1 begin\n' "$(stamp)" "$0" "${1:-}" >> "$log_file"
trap 'result=$?; printf "%s script=%s exit=%s\n" "$(stamp)" "$0" "$result" >> "$log_file"' EXIT
run_output=$(/var/jb/bin/sh -s -- "$@" 2>&1 <<'GOFAHUD_SCRIPT_BODY'
set -eu
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
if [ ! -x /var/jb/usr/bin/jbctl ]; then
    echo 'GOFA HUD requires Dopamine rootless (jbctl).' >&2
    exit 1
fi
case "${1:-}" in
    install|upgrade)
        launchctl bootout system/local.gofahud.drive-recorder >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        launchctl bootout system/local.gofahud.native-speed >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        launchctl bootout system/local.gofahud.diagnostics >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        ;;
esac
exit 0

GOFAHUD_SCRIPT_BODY
)
run_result=$?
printf "%s\n" "$run_output" >> "$log_file"
printf "%s\n" "$run_output"
exit "$run_result"
control.postinst:
#!/var/jb/bin/sh
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
log_dir=/var/mobile/Library/Logs
mkdir -p "$log_dir"
log_file="$log_dir/GofaHUD-install.log"
touch "$log_file"; chmod 0644 "$log_file"
stamp() { TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'; }
printf '%s script=%s action=%s version=0.3.1 begin\n' "$(stamp)" "$0" "${1:-}" >> "$log_file"
trap 'result=$?; printf "%s script=%s exit=%s\n" "$(stamp)" "$0" "$result" >> "$log_file"' EXIT
run_output=$(/var/jb/bin/sh -s -- "$@" 2>&1 <<'GOFAHUD_SCRIPT_BODY'
set -eu
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
# Exact CodeDirectory hashes for every installed Mach-O slice.
for digest in c4209b84689e196dc917ee60efb43dc13f4c37e7 938fd2270f742a28058d9ad688fd2cad9030ce53 e91b9b56a20bf9e9b01270b81dda4383716b634f 02b47aabc87822436eab865deb584304d6dd9f61 fd8fa4539a4816fa8ab374b1c6fd4d58f1e33d02 92ef3aeedafc3a928181b6b05e89fb60a396c931 d98ed874c8c409b60d909f8bc7b070c9fac9a280 78c4931cd89478de430aeb420ddc2f4c8113f2af c7e4b3d14785575bbde57e80c244d867a3600aed b12eab6e794697f82ba8588b4b76c8e402acdbd0 ac7ab3be639ae249e27e865dc132abb02722b0cb d1ff04637a5fa25a8ae61596b18ba6da8372c8a3 65150526ed9986160703690a0485d1ca61a2f271 9765366fa0cc5a2b7b5b6cbff7389dc5974b9a63 69934a0d8cc8fe10cc6684f91dcc5ab546d8e8d6 ed48a58329d26e7c1eeeada73158bb98f4b2e615; do
 /var/jb/usr/bin/jbctl trustcache add "$digest" || exit 1
done
for label in native-speed drive-recorder diagnostics; do
    launchctl bootout "system/local.gofahud.$label" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    launchctl bootstrap system "/var/jb/Library/LaunchDaemons/local.gofahud.$label.plist"
done
echo 'GOFA HUD installed. Respring to load the bubbles, then reopen GOFA.'
exit 0

GOFAHUD_SCRIPT_BODY
)
run_result=$?
printf "%s\n" "$run_output" >> "$log_file"
printf "%s\n" "$run_output"
exit "$run_result"
